stem: Define degree of dissociation. Derive Ostwald's dilution law for the \(\mathrm{CH_3COOH}\).
Define pH and pOH. Derive relationship between pH and pOH.
What is meant by hydrolysis ? A solution of \(\mathrm{CH_3COONH_4}\) is neutral. why ?
Dissociation of \(\mathrm{HCN}\) is suppressed by the addition of \(\mathrm{HCl}\). Explain.
Derive the relationship between degree of dissociation and dissociation constant in weak electrolytes.

Sulfides of cation of group II are precipitated in acidic solution (\(\mathrm{H_2S}\) + \(\mathrm{HCl}\)) whereas sulfides of cations of group IIIB are precipitated in ammoniacal solution of \(\mathrm{H_2S}\). Comment on the relative values of solubility product of sulfides of these.
Solubility of a sparingly soluble salt get affected in presence of a soluble salt having one common ion. Explain.
The pH of rain water collected in a certain region of Maharashtra on particular day was 5.1. Calculate the \(\mathrm{H^{\oplus}}\) ion concentration of the rain water and its percent dissociation.
Explain the relation between ionic product and solubility product to predict whether a precipitate will form when two solutions are mixed?
